title: Acquaintances say Puharich was Mossad

tellings.quote: multiple people who knew him who never really said anything until much later in their lives, um, told me that he he was Mossad.

plain: Andrija Puharich, a scientist linked to the CIA who said he made contact with an alien council, was secretly working for Mossad, Israel's intelligence service, in the 1970s. That is what the researcher Greg Malatzi says several people who knew Puharich told him, though they kept quiet about it until late in their lives. If true, Puharich's contact work may have been tied to a foreign spy agency.
